Diabetic Retinopathy Detection

02 · MAJOR PROJECT · 2026 · 8TH SEMESTER
REAL-TIME SAFETY VISION

PPE Compliance Detection System

Real-time worker protection detection connected to a full operational dashboard.

YOLOv8n trained for 100 epochs on a GTX 1650 using 1,132 Construction-PPE images. IoU person–PPE association drives SAFE, LOW, MEDIUM, and HIGH risk states across a React + Node + FastAPI + PostgreSQL + Docker system.
